title: The Life and Work of Marie Curie

sentences.en: Marie Curie is probably the most famous woman scientist who has ever lived.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·居里可能是有史以来最著名的女科学家

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Born Maria Sklodowska in Poland in 1867, she is famous for her work on radioactivity, and was twice a winner of the Nobel Prize.
sentences.zh: 1867年生于波兰的Maria Sklodowska, 她以从事放射性工作而出名, 曾两次得诺贝尔奖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: With her husband, Pierre Curie, and Henri Becquerel, she was awarded the 1903 Nobel Prize for Physics, and was then sole winner of the 1911 Nobel Prize for Chemistry.
sentences.zh: 她与丈夫皮埃尔·库里和亨利·贝克奎尔一起,获得了1903年诺贝尔物理奖,当时是1911年诺贝尔化学奖的唯一得主。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: She was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize.
sentences.zh: 她是第一个获得诺贝尔奖的女人

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: From childhood, Marie was remarkable for her prodigious memory, and at the age of 16 won a gold medal on completion of her secondary education.
sentences.zh: Marie从小就以其非凡的记忆为荣,16岁时在完成中等教育后获得金牌。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Because her father lost his savings through bad investment, she then had to take work as a teacher.
sentences.zh: 因为她父亲因为投资不善而失去积蓄,她不得不当老师。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: From her earnings she was able to finance her sister Bronia’s medical studies in Paris, on the understanding that Bronia would, in turn, later help her to get an education.
sentences.zh: 她能从收入中为她姐姐Bronia在巴黎的医学研究提供资金,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In 1891 this promise was fulfilled and Marie went to Paris and began to study at the Sorbonne (the University of Paris).
sentences.zh: 1891年,这一承诺得到了履行,Marie前往巴黎,开始在索邦(巴黎大学)学习。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: She often worked far into the night and lived on little more than bread and butter and tea.
sentences.zh: 她经常工作到深夜,只靠面包、黄油和茶为生。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: She came first in the examination in the physical sciences in 1893, and in 1894 was placed second in the examination in mathematical sciences.
sentences.zh: 1893年,她首先参加物理科学考试,1894年,她成为数学考试第二名。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It was not until the spring of that year that she was introduced to Pierre Curie.
sentences.zh: 直到当年春天她才被介绍给Pierre Curie。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Their marriage in 1895 marked the start of a partnership that was soon to achieve results of world significance.
sentences.zh: 1895年,他们的婚姻标志着伙伴关系的开始,这种伙伴关系很快将取得具有世界意义的成果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 伙伴关系伙伴关系伙伴关系

sentences.en: Following Henri Becquerel’s discovery in 1896 of a new phenomenon, which Marie later called ‘radioactivity’, Marie Curie decided to find out if the radioactivity discovered in uranium was to be found in other elements.
sentences.zh: 1896年亨利·贝克奎尔发现一个新现象后(Marie后来称之为“放射性”), 玛丽·库里决定查证铀中发现的放射性是否在其他元素中被发现。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: She discovered that this was true for thorium.
sentences.zh: 她发现是这样的

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Turning her attention to minerals, she found her interest drawn to pitchblende, a mineral whose radioactivity, superior to that of pure uranium, could be explained only by the presence in the ore of small quantities of an unknown substance of very high activity.
sentences.zh: 她在谈到矿物时发现,她对Tridgeblede感兴趣,因为后者的放射性高于纯铀,其唯一解释是矿子中存在少量活动非常高的未知物质。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Pierre Curie joined her in the work that she had undertaken to resolve this problem, and that led to the discovery of the new elements, polonium and radium.
sentences.zh: 皮埃尔·居里与她一起为解决这一问题开展了工作,并由此发现了新的元素,即和。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: While Pierre Curie devoted himself chiefly to the physical study of the new radiations, Marie Curie struggled to obtain pure radium in the metallic state.
sentences.zh: 皮埃尔·居里主要致力于对新辐射进行物理研究,而玛丽·居里则努力争取在金属状态下获得纯的放射性。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This was achieved with the help of the chemist André-Louis Debierne, one of Pierre Curie’s pupils.
sentences.zh: 这项工作是在皮埃尔·库里的学生之一化学家安德烈-路易·德比耶内的帮助下完成的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Based on the results of this research, Marie Curie received her Doctorate of Science, and in 1903 Marie and Pierre shared with Becquerel the Nobel Prize for Physics for the discovery of radioactivity.
sentences.zh: 根据这项研究的结果,Marie Curie获得了她的科学博士学位,1903年,Marie和Pierre与Becquereel分享了发现放射性的诺贝尔物理奖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 结果结果结果结果结果

sentences.en: The births of Marie’s two daughters, Irène and Eve, in 1897 and 1904 failed to interrupt her scientific work.
sentences.zh: 1897年和1904年,Marie的两个女儿Irène和Eve出生,但未能中断她的科研工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: She was appointed lecturer in physics at the École Normale Supérieure for girls in Sèvres, France (1900), and introduced a method of teaching based on experimental demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 她被任命为法国塞夫雷斯高等高等中学女教师,并采用实验示范教学方法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In December 1904 she was appointed chief assistant in the laboratory directed by Pierre Curie.
sentences.zh: 1904年12月,她被任命为皮埃尔·库里领导的实验室首席助理。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

words.def: 助理助理助理助理助理助理

sentences.en: The sudden death of her husband in 1906 was a bitter blow to Marie Curie, but was also a turning point in her career: henceforth she was to devote all her energy to completing alone the scientific work that they had undertaken.
sentences.zh: 1906年她丈夫突然去世,对玛丽·库里来说是一次痛苦的打击,但也是她职业生涯的一个转折点:从此以后,她将全力以赴地单独完成他们所从事的科学工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: On May 13, 1906, she was appointed to the professorship that had been left vacant on her husband’s death, becoming the first woman to teach at the Sorbonne.
sentences.zh: 1906年5月13日,她被任命为教授,该教授因丈夫去世而空缺,成为第一个在索邦大学任教的妇女。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In 1911 she was awarded the Nobel Prize for Chemistry for the isolation of a pure form of radium.
sentences.zh: 1911年,她因隔离一种纯放射性的放射性核而获得诺贝尔化学奖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: During World War I, Marie Curie, with the help of her daughter Irène, devoted herself to the development of the use of X-radiography, including the mobile units which came to be known as ‘Little Curies’, used for the treatment of wounded soldiers.
sentences.zh: 包括被称为`小库里斯 ' 的移动设备, 用于治疗受伤士兵。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In 1918 the Radium Institute, whose staff Irène had joined, began to operate in earnest, and became a centre for nuclear physics and chemistry.
sentences.zh: 1918年,Al-Radium研究所开始认真运作,成为核物理和化学中心,其工作人员Irène也加入了该研究所。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Marie Curie, now at the highest point of her fame and, from 1922, a member of the Academy of Medicine, researched the chemistry of radioactive substances and their medical applications.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·居里,现在她名声最高,从1922年起,是医学院的一位成员,她研究放射性物质的化学及其医疗应用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In 1921, accompanied by her two daughters, Marie Curie made a triumphant journey to the United States to raise funds for research on radium.
sentences.zh: 1921年,在她的两个女儿的陪同下,玛丽·库里成功前往美国,为研究放射性核子筹集资金。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Women there presented her with a gram of radium for her campaign.
sentences.zh: 当地妇女向她展示了用于竞选的一克射线杆菌。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Marie also gave lectures in Belgium, Brazil, Spain and Czechoslovakia and, in addition, had the satisfaction of seeing the development of the Curie Foundation in Paris, and the inauguration in 1932 in Warsaw of the Radium Institute, where her sister Bronia became director.
sentences.zh: 玛丽还在比利时、巴西、西班牙和捷克斯洛伐克讲课,此外,她满意地看到巴黎的Curie基金会的发展,以及1932年在华沙的Radium研究所落成,她的姐姐Bronia在华沙担任所长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: One of Marie Curie’s outstanding achievements was to have understood the need to accumulate intense radioactive sources, not only to treat illness but also to maintain an abundant supply for research.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·居里杰出成就之一是理解有必要积累密集的放射源,不仅治疗疾病,而且维持丰富的研究供应。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The existence in Paris at the Radium Institute of a stock of 1.5 grams of radium made a decisive contribution to the success of the experiments undertaken in the years around 1930.
sentences.zh: 在巴黎的研究所存在1.5克的放射性铀,对1930年前后进行的实验取得成功作出了决定性贡献。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This work prepared the way for the discovery of the neutron by Sir James Chadwick and, above all, for the discovery in 1934 by Irène and Frédéric Joliot-Curie of artificial radioactivity.
sentences.zh: 这项工作为詹姆斯·查德维克爵士发现中子铺平了道路,最重要的是为伊雷内和弗雷德里克·乔利奥特-库里1934年发现人造放射性创造了道路。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A few months after this discovery, Marie Curie died as a result of leukaemia caused by exposure to radiation.
sentences.zh: 发现后几个月,Marie Curie死于辐射照射造成的白血病。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: She had often carried test tubes containing radioactive isotopes in her pocket, remarking on the pretty blue-green light they gave off.
sentences.zh: 她经常在口袋里携带含有放射性同位素的试验管,说他们发出的蓝色光亮非常亮。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Her contribution to physics had been immense, not only in her own work, the importance of which had been demonstrated by her two Nobel Prizes, but because of her influence on subsequent generations of nuclear physicists and chemists.
sentences.zh: 她对物理学的贡献是巨大的,不仅在她自己的工作中,其重要性已经从她的两次诺贝尔奖中显示出来,而且因为她对以后几代核物理学家和化学家的影响。
